newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mariner Health cut. [CORRECTED 09:10 GMT 12/10]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mariner Health cut. [CORRECTED 09:10 GMT 12/10]

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it cut its rating on Mariner Health Group Inc to hold from buy (Corrects previous rating from "strong buy").
-- The stock sold off on Thursday after the company said it would take a one-time charge of $10 million in the third quarter to increase reserves covering changes in Medicare reimbursements.
The company said it also foresees a 20 percent decrease from analysts' per share earnings estimates for the third quarter and subsequent quarters.
